h1: Turnkey custom kitchens in Vienna — design, manufacturing, delivery, and installation

blocks.text: Turnkey custom kitchens in Vienna — design, manufacturing, delivery, and installation

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN makes turnkey custom kitchens for apartments and houses in Vienna: measurement, design, 3D visualization, manufacturing at our own production facility in Bratislava, delivery, installation, and the fitting of appliances. Delivery to Vienna is included in the price, and the installation is carried out by our own crew.
You can choose one of the 32 models in our catalog and adapt it to the dimensions of your kitchen, or order a fully bespoke design. Prices for Vienna are the same as for Bratislava.

blocks.title: Kitchens for Vienna
rows: included in the price, our own crew

items: Site measurement of the room with the positions of utilities, windows, doors, and appliances.
Design and layout — straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, with an island or peninsula, or an open-plan kitchen and living area.
3D visualization — you see the kitchen in your interior before production starts.
Technical design — cabinet drawings, an appliance connection diagram, and a specification of materials and hardware.
Manufacturing at our own production facility in Bratislava.
Delivery and installation in Vienna by our own crew, with adjustment of the fronts and mechanisms.
Fitting of appliances — oven, cooktop, range hood, dishwasher, refrigerator.

parts.html: Fronts: laminated chipboard, foil-wrapped MDF, painted MDF, veneer, HPL, acrylic, glass. Countertops: laminate, compact laminate, engineered quartz, porcelain stoneware, acrylic stone, and natural stone. Hettich, Blum, and Häfele hardware: soft-close mechanisms, pull-out systems, lift-up mechanisms, cargo pull-outs, organizers, and waste sorting systems.
The configuration is tailored to your budget — from standard to premium. Every catalog model lists the materials it is made of, and these can be changed.

blocks.text: How to order a kitchen in Vienna

items: Inquiry. Send us a floor plan or the dimensions of your kitchen, photos, and examples of designs you like — or choose a model from the catalog.
Preliminary quote. Within a few days, we give you an approximate price.
Measurement and design. We come to Vienna to take measurements, develop the design and 3D visualization, and agree on the materials.
Final price and contract. One amount for the kitchen, including delivery and installation.
Production, delivery, installation. We manufacture in Bratislava, deliver and install in Vienna, and fit the appliances.

blocks.text: Questions about custom kitchens in Vienna

items.q: How much does a turnkey kitchen cost in Vienna?
items.a: The price depends on the dimensions, the materials of the fronts and countertop, the hardware, and the appliances. We give you the exact price after the measurement and design — as one amount, including delivery to Vienna and installation. For a guide to model prices, see the catalog.

items.q: Is there a charge for delivery to Vienna?
items.a: No, delivery and installation are included in the price of the kitchen. There are no extra charges for the trip from Bratislava.
The lead time depends on the scope, materials, and current production workload — we confirm it with the quote. It starts once the design is approved and the deposit is paid.

items.q: Can a catalog model be modified?
items.a: Yes. The dimensions, front color, countertop, interior fittings, and appliances are tailored to your kitchen — the catalog model serves as a starting point.
During installation, we install and fit the appliances. Water, gas, and electrical connections are part of the renovation work — if our crew is doing the renovation, it is all handled as one project.

items.q: Do you make kitchens for houses outside Vienna?
items.a: Yes — in Lower Austria and Burgenland, within a comfortable travel radius of Bratislava.
